req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-026 requires that every /players/* endpoint returning a body must respond with Content-Type: application/json. We must verify this for all body-returning endpoints (GET /players/, GET /players/{id}, GET /players/squadnumber/{n}, POST /players/) and confirm that no-body endpoints (PUT 204, DELETE 204) are excluded from the requirement. Tests cover: positive EP (GET all returns application/json), positive EP (GET by squad number returns application/json), positive EP (GET by UUID returns application/json), positive EP (POST 201 returns application/json), boundary BVA (exact header value including charset variant), negative NEG (4xx error responses also carry application/json), and DT covering multiple endpoints systematically. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact string 'application/json' in the Content-Type header, not just its presence, and by checking status codes exactly.

    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/1')

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_no_body_endpoints_do_not_violate_requirement():
    client = TestClient(app)
    put_payload = {
        'firstName': 'Anjali',
        'lastName': 'Banerjee',
        'squadNumber': 1,
        'position': 'Defensive Midfield'
    }
    r_put = client.put('/players/squadnumber/1', json=put_payload)
    assert r_put.status_code == 204
    assert r_put.content == b''
    r_del = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert r_del.status_code == 204
    assert r_del.content == b''

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_content_type_not_text_html_on_get_all():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    assert 'text/html' not in ct
    assert 'text/plain' not in ct
    assert 'application/xml' not in ct
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 26
